metadata.description: Live-captured (via direct SDK-client probe -- see below) GET /api/mdm/profiles/{profileId} immediately after DeleteProfileAsync, UEM 26.2.0.0, 2026-07-30. mock-capture's CLI cannot write a fixture for an error response (main.go calls log.Fatalf on any non-2xx before reaching the fixture-writing code), so this fixture was hand-assembled from the genuine error text returned by the live call (status 400, errorCode 400, message "Invalid Profile <id>.") with the real profile id replaced by the same anonymized placeholder (68910) used across this platform's other fixtures. Confirms deletion was real, not a silent no-op. Shadowed by profiles_apple_get_after_create.json under the same literal path in a full-corpus load, so exercised via an isolated single-fixture mock server (see TestGeneratedProfilesV2AppleGetAfterDelete).
